expected.fmt:
import TestHooks, expect_equal from "@std/test/test.ms"

type Counter:
	count: Int

fn make_fixture() Counter:
	return Counter(0)

fn var Counter.before_each() Unit!:
	self.count = 0

test "increments":
	fixture.count += 1
	expect_equal(fixture.count, 1)?

test "starts fresh":
	expect_equal(fixture.count, 0)?
